messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: p99 latency SLO breach detected on cont-batch serving path (streaming) in us-west-2. p99=2.1s, SLO=1.2s, p95=0.9s. Affected routes: /v1/chat/stream (customer-facing). Paging primary oncall @anna-oncall.

anna-oncall: acked. looking at traces now, pulling last 30m.

anna-oncall: dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/contbatch/streaming?orgId=1 (sharing snapshot). p99 spike correlates with increase in batch size and KV miss rate.

mike-sre: hopping in. quick hypothesis: mixed sequence-length traffic caused batch multiplier to grow and scheduler favored long sequences -> tail amplification. also saw streaming stalls ~1:10:00 mark.

sara-ml: +1. model KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 68% around spike, which will cause paging into slower path. Could be prefetch/kv-evict thrash.

jason-platform: any recent deploys to batcher or scheduler?

deploy-bot: deploy: batcher-service v3.8.1 -> v3.9.0 rolled to us-west-2 at 2024-11-08T09:12Z by @ci-cd. changelog: scheduling fairness tweak, new adaptive batching heuristic.

mike-sre: hmm that timeframe aligns. suggestion for live mitigation: reduce max_batch_size on cont-batch nodes from 64 -> 32, and enable preemptive-shed for >1s queued reqs. cheap, reversible.

anna-oncall: can we do a targeted change for streaming lane only? want to avoid global perf regressions.

jason-platform: yes we have config flutter that supports per-route batching overrides. patch sound: 
```
route_overrides:
  /v1/chat/stream:
    max_batch_size: 32
    queue_timeout_ms: 300
```
apply to us-west-2 pool.

mike-sre: also add schedule weight: long-seq -> weight 0.6, short-seq -> 1.2 (temporary) to restore fairness.

anna-oncall: applying route override now. will monitor p95/p99 and KV hit-rate.

deploy-bot: start rollout: config patch /v1/chat/stream -> us-west-2 pool. rolling to 12 nodes.

ops-bot: autoscaler: nodes in us-west-2 at 09:18Z: 48 -> 60 (scale-up triggered by CPU+queue).

anna-oncall: initial impact metrics after change (1m): p99 dropped to 1.05s, p95 steady at 0.85s. KV hit-rate recovering slowly (now 76%).

sara-ml: good signal. lower batch size reduces padding amplification and KV churn. still want to follow up on KV eviction policy.

lina-eng-manager: rough customer impact calc? we need to notify support if >5 customers affected.

anna-oncall: estimate based on logs: ~1.1k requests in 15m above 1.2s, ~320 unique API keys, top 3 affected customers saw >2x latency.

lina-eng-manager: opening incident ticket INC-2024-432, assigning to customer success and support for outreach.

mike-sre: next steps for live mitigation: 1) keep per-route override for 2h 2) cadence to revert once KV hit-rate >90% and p99 stable <1.2s 3) schedule a patch to scheduler to better handle mixed seq lengths (long tasks shouldn't starve short ones).

jason-platform: I'll prepare a hotfix branch to add seq-length-aware token trimming and queue weighting. dropping long-seq batch cap by default for streaming routes.

anna-oncall: will keep monitoring. adding automations: alert if p99 >1.2s for >5m OR KV hit-rate <70% for >10m.

deploy-bot: config rollout completed to all 12 nodes at 09:22Z. no errors.

anna-oncall: 09:25Z check: p99=0.94s, p95=0.82s, error rate unchanged. rolling average for 15m looks stable. marking as "mitigated" for live ops but not resolved.

sara-ml: creating eval job to reproduce mixed sequence amplification locally; will run on representative traffic mix and measure batch-size vs tail latency.

mike-sre: reminder for post-incident: capture scheduling logs, JVMTI traces (batcher threads), and kernel-level queuing stats. aim for a 1-pager and RCA.

lina-eng-manager: assign RCA owners: sara-ml (root cause + mitigations), jason-platform (scheduler fix + rollout plan), mike-sre (operational runbook updates). I'll own customer comms.

anna-oncall: handing off to next oncall @mike-sre in 20m. leaving current state + links: dashboard snapshot, applied config gist: https://internal.gists/contbatch/2912345678.

mike-sre: taking over. thanks @anna-oncall. I'll watch through the window and keep postmortem cadence. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: NOTE: incident severity set to SEV3 (customer latency, degraded experience). linked ticket INC-2024-432.

lina-eng-manager: thanks team — follow-up actions tracked in INC-2024-432 and a small retro scheduled tomorrow 10:00am to discuss batching heuristics and KV eviction tuning. :calendar:
